```{r}
library(DT)
library(rvest)
library(FLCore)

extract_dir <- "extracted"

# the objects found in the submitted files, from make_inventory.R
inventory <- read.csv("inventory.csv")

# the submissions table, from the saved copy of
# https://data.ices.dk/submissions/ViewSubmissions/StockAssessmentResultsSubmissions
submissions <- html_table(html_element(read_html("ids.html"), "table"))
names(submissions) <- trimws(names(submissions))
submissions <- submissions[!duplicated(submissions$ID), ]

# what the page says about each submission, leaving out the email address
info <- data.frame(
  id = submissions$ID,
  Submitted = submissions$`Submission datetime`,
  Year = submissions$Year,
  `Stock code` = submissions$StockCode,
  Purpose = submissions$Purpose,
  `Case number` = submissions$`Case Number`,
  Notes = submissions$Notes,
  check.names = FALSE
)

submissions <- data.frame(
  id = submissions$ID,
  submitted = as.Date(submissions$`Submission datetime`, format = "%d-%m-%Y"),
  stock = submissions$StockCode,
  year = submissions$Year,
  purpose = submissions$Purpose,
  notes = submissions$Notes
)

# counts of what each submission contains
count_by_id <- function(rows) {
  as.vector(table(factor(inventory$id[rows], levels = submissions$id)))
}
submissions$files <- count_by_id(!duplicated(inventory[c("id", "file")]))
submissions$objects <- count_by_id(TRUE)
submissions$flstocks <- count_by_id(inventory$class == "FLStock")
submissions <- submissions[order(submissions$submitted, decreasing = TRUE), ]

# one row per object, with the submission it came from
objects <- merge(
  submissions[c("id", "submitted", "stock", "year", "purpose")],
  inventory,
  by = "id"
)
objects <- objects[order(objects$submitted, objects$id, objects$file, decreasing = TRUE), ]
objects$md5 <- substr(objects$md5, 1, 8)

# a table that can be sorted, searched and filtered by column
show_table <- function(data, long = character(), escape = TRUE) {
  # short text columns get a dropdown filter
  for (col in setdiff(names(data), c("id", "md5", long))) {
    if (is.character(data[[col]]) && length(unique(data[[col]])) <= 60) {
      data[[col]] <- factor(data[[col]])
    }
  }
  datatable(
    data,
    rownames = FALSE,
    escape = escape,
    filter = "top",
    class = "compact stripe hover nowrap",
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
      scrollX = TRUE,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("pageLength", "colvis", "csv")
    )
  )
}
```

# Overview

`r nrow(submissions)` submissions, containing `r nrow(inventory)` objects in
`r sum(submissions$files)` data files. `r sum(submissions$flstocks)` of the
objects are `FLStock` objects, from `r sum(submissions$flstocks > 0)`
submissions.

Each table can be sorted by clicking a column heading, searched with the box
at the top right, and filtered with the boxes under the column headings.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Submissions

One row per submission. `files`, `objects` and `flstocks` count what was found
in the submitted zip file; a submission with no files contained no data. The
`id` links to the section for that submission, further down the page.

```{r}
linked <- submissions
linked$id <- sprintf('<a href="#sub-%s">%s</a>', linked$id, linked$id)
show_table(linked, long = "notes", escape = FALSE)
```

## FLStock objects

One row per `FLStock` object. `dim` is ages x years x units x seasons x areas
x iterations.

```{r}
flstocks <- objects[objects$class == "FLStock", ]
flstocks <- flstocks[setdiff(names(flstocks), c("format", "size", "class"))]
show_table(flstocks, long = c("file", "object", "name", "desc"))
```

## All objects

One row per object, of any class. Objects inside a list are named with the
list they are in, for example `res$stk`. Files with the same `md5` are
identical.

```{r}
show_table(objects, long = c("file", "object", "name", "desc"))
```

:::

# Submissions

One section per submission, newest first: what the submissions page says
about it, then a summary of each object in the submitted files. Warnings given
by R when reading or summarising the files are listed as notes.

```{r}
# Run some code, keeping the warnings it gives.
#
# Returns a list with the value (a "try-error" if the code failed) and the
# warnings as notes, a character vector.

with_notes <- function(expr) {
  notes <- character()
  value <- withCallingHandlers(
    try(expr, silent = TRUE),
    warning = function(warning) {
      notes <<- c(notes, trimws(conditionMessage(warning)))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    },
    message = function(message) invokeRestart("muffleMessage")
  )
  list(value = value, notes = unique(notes))
}

# The files in a submission, with the files inside any zip files.
#
# Returns a data frame of paths and the labels to show for them.

submission_files <- function(dir, label = "") {
  paths <- list.files(dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  files <- data.frame(path = paths, label = paste0(label, substring(paths, nchar(dir) + 2)))
  is_zip <- vapply(paths, function(path) identical(readBin(path, "raw", 2), charToRaw("PK")), TRUE)
  inside <- lapply(which(is_zip), function(i) {
    zip_dir <- tempfile("zip")
    unzip(files$path[i], exdir = zip_dir)
    submission_files(zip_dir, paste0(files$label[i], "/"))
  })
  do.call(rbind, c(list(files[!is_zip, ]), inside))
}

# Read the objects in a file, in the same way as make_inventory.R.
#
# Returns a list with the objects (NULL if the file is not data) and the
# notes from reading the file.

read_objects <- function(file) {
  read <- with_notes({
    env <- new.env()
    load(file, envir = env)
    as.list(env)
  })
  if (inherits(read$value, "try-error")) {
    read <- with_notes(list(readRDS(file)))
  }
  if (inherits(read$value, "try-error") && grepl("\\.(csv|txt)$", file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    read <- with_notes(list(read.csv(file, check.names = FALSE)))
  }
  if (inherits(read$value, "try-error")) {
    return(list(objects = NULL, notes = character()))
  }
  list(objects = read$value, notes = read$notes)
}

# Show an object, and the objects inside it if it is a list.
#
# Returns the notes from summarising the object.

show_object <- function(object, name) {
  cat("**", if (!is.null(name) && name != "") paste0("`", name, "`: "), class(object)[1], "**\n\n", sep = "")

  if (identical(class(object), "list") && length(object) > 0) {
    names <- names(object)
    if (is.null(names)) names <- rep("", length(object))
    names <- ifelse(is.na(names) | names == "", paste0("[[", seq_along(object), "]]"), names)
    if (!is.null(name) && name != "") names <- paste(name, names, sep = "$")
    notes <- lapply(seq_along(object), function(i) show_object(object[[i]], names[i]))
    return(unlist(notes))
  }

  # FLR objects have a summary, anything else is shown by its structure
  shown <- with_notes(capture.output(
    if (isS4(object)) summary(object) else str(object, max.level = 1, list.len = 20, vec.len = 2)
  ))
  if (inherits(shown$value, "try-error")) {
    shown$notes <- c(shown$notes, paste("no summary:", trimws(conditionMessage(attr(shown$value, "condition")))))
    shown$value <- character()
  }
  text <- shown$value
  if (length(text) > 60) text <- c(text[1:60], "...")
  if (length(text) > 0) cat("````text", text, "````", "", sep = "\n")

  if (length(shown$notes) > 0) paste0(name, ": ", shown$notes) else character()
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (id in submissions$id) {
  cat("\n\n## ", submissions$stock[submissions$id == id], ", ", format(submissions$submitted[submissions$id == id]),
    " {#sub-", id, "}\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  about <- info[info$id == id, ]
  about$Download <- paste0("https://data.ices.dk/filearchive/GetFileByFileID/", id)
  about <- data.frame(field = c("ID", names(about)[-1]), value = unlist(about))
  cat(knitr::kable(about, format = "html", row.names = FALSE, col.names = NULL, table.attr = 'class="table table-sm w-auto"'), "\n\n")

  notes <- character()
  files <- submission_files(file.path(extract_dir, id))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(files))) {
    read <- read_objects(files$path[i])
    if (is.null(read$objects)) {
      notes <- c(notes, paste0("`", files$label[i], "` was skipped, it is not a data file"))
      next
    }
    cat("### ", files$label[i], " {.unlisted}\n\n", sep = "")
    for (j in seq_along(read$objects)) {
      read$notes <- c(read$notes, show_object(read$objects[[j]], names(read$objects)[j]))
    }
    if (length(read$notes) > 0) {
      notes <- c(notes, paste0("`", files$label[i], "`: ", unique(read$notes)))
    }

    # the same file in another submission
    md5 <- inventory$md5[inventory$id == id & inventory$file == files$label[i]][1]
    same <- setdiff(unique(inventory$id[inventory$md5 %in% md5]), id)
    if (length(same) > 0) {
      notes <- c(notes, paste0(
        "`", files$label[i], "` is identical to the file in ",
        paste0("[", same, "](#sub-", same, ")", collapse = ", ")
      ))
    }
  }
  if (nrow(files) == 0) notes <- c(notes, "the zip file was empty")

  if (length(notes) > 0) {
    cat("### Notes {.unlisted}\n\n", paste0("- ", gsub("\\s+", " ", notes), "\n"), "\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
